title: Granada trip
text:
Katya is an outstanding tour guide with an amazing fund of Knowledge.
My family & I enjoyed her company for a 3-day tour of Granada & AlHambra.
Boris (Her cute dog) joined us and was so much fun. My kids won’t stop talking about him.
I have travelled all over the world & my trip to Granada will always be memorable mostly because of Katya planning & guidance.
author: Abdullahms1

title: Katya is the best
text: Katya was a wonderful and fun tour guide.  She went above and beyond to provide a special experience on our private tour on our first trip to Alhambra. The communication and instructions from her prior to the tour were very helpful. I highly recommend her and wish that she was in every city!
author: Stay583590

title: more than a visit an invitation to connect
text: Thank you very much for making me feel part of the monument itself. I become with a lot of creative inspiration and eager to expand my ideas. I learned a lot and it was very enjoyable, super recommended 100%
author: mar_at359
